titulo: ALL the ways to get FREE BOSS COINS em OSM | Promo Code 2024?  | OSM PRO

linhas.text: Everyone loves Boss Coins, they help a lot in the game, especially for the people who
play more competitive OSM.
Welcome to OSM Pro Channel, the best Online Soccer Manager Channel in the world.
In this short video we will discover the 6th unique ways to earn Boss Coins in OSM.
Pay close attention to each one of them.
I will leave the best for last.
First option, free.
OSM offers 1 Boss Coin every 8 hours, so don't forget to go and collect them.
Second option, watch videos.
In OSM you can watch 6 videos per hour.
3 of them in the club and free Boss Coins option and 3 more when you click on shop.
Using the mobile phone application you can watch 3 more videos by clicking here, totaling
a maximum of 9 Boss Coins per hour using this method.
Attention, you can earn 3 more per day, click on the club money and then 3 more videos come.
Third option, promotional codes.
This information is official and was given by Special One, an admin and employee of
Game Basics and Miniclip.
And he told us, this promo code system has not been used for a long time and even in
the last situation in which OSM gives Boss Coins compensation to players, the process
used is different, so it is expected that this system will be removed from the game.
There are no promo codes and there will never be any more promo codes.
This is official information.
Fourth option, world domination.
This is a funny way to earn Boss Coins.
Just complete the objective on each of the 4 continents.
For each continent you earn a thousand Boss Coins, I think.
When you dominate the 4 continents, you dominate the world and earn 4000 more Boss Coins.
Fifth option, achievements.
In the OSM there are several missions that give you Boss Coins.
Pay attention to each one, some are easy to accomplish and others are quite difficult.
Sixth option, play other games.
Finally we have the option that give us more Boss Coins.
I use them.
To increase the effectiveness of this method, do it during the triple Boss Coins event,
as you will earn many more Boss Coins.
For this method, use the application on your cell phone and visit the free option
in the right menu, then choose one of the three options on the left.
These applications and games will appear that you can play.
Choose the most advantageous and easiest to implement.
Pay attention to three aspects.
Whether the missions are realistic and possible to complete, the time you have to complete
the mission and finally remember that this has to be the first time you install this
application on your cell phone.
In this first example we managed to earn, after a few hours of play, 1200 Boss Coins.
It seems like a good option.
In this other example, we have a game that gives 124,000 Boss Coins, but only the
first five objectives can be achieved without spending real money.
But maybe is good too.
But now, here we have a completely unrealistic example, because is impossible you reach
this level in this game.
So choose well.
If the reward does not arrive after completing the objectives, contact support at the
same location where you accept the mission.
